task.prompt:
Please write the PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL procedure described in design_document.md. Use this exact signature: sp(arg1 integer, arg2 text, arg3 integer, arg4 integer, arg5 text, arg6 integer).

Arguments: arg1 is the player height limit; arg2 is unused; arg3 is the baseline player API number; arg4 is the minimum team API number; arg5 is the requested team long-name value; arg6 is the baseline team FIFA API number.

Please return the complete stored procedure, and nothing else.

materials.text:
Implement the football cleanup as PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL procedure sp(arg1 integer, arg2 text, arg3 integer, arg4 integer, arg5 text, arg6 integer).

Parameter guide: arg1 is the height limit for the remaining-player weight bump; arg2 is unused; arg3 is the baseline player API number; arg4 is the minimum team API number for the long-name update; arg5 is the requested team long-name value; arg6 is the baseline team FIFA API number.

The procedure works only on players, teams, player skill snapshots, and team tactical snapshots. Country records and league records are not part of this cleanup.

Run nine cleanup phases in order. In phase i, from 1 through 9, mark every current player’s birthday text with that phase’s marker, 'phase_1' through 'phase_9'; remove current players whose player API number is below arg3 + i - 1; mark every current team’s short team code with that phase’s marker, 'log_phase_1' through 'log_phase_9'; then remove current teams whose team FIFA API number is below arg6 + i - 1. Later phases and later corrections only see rows left by earlier work.

After the phase pass, increase weight by 1 for each remaining player whose height is below arg1.

If arg5 is not NULL, set the long team name to arg5 for current teams whose short team code is 'log_phase_9' and whose team API number is at least arg4.

Then correct player skill snapshots by setting potential to overall rating where the snapshot’s player API number is at least arg3 + 8 and potential is below overall rating. This does not depend on whether the player still exists.

Finally, correct team tactical snapshots by setting defensive aggression to defensive pressure where defensive aggression is below defensive pressure, but only when a current team with the same team API number has team FIFA API number at least arg6 + 8.

Use normal PL/pgSQL behavior; no explicit transaction control or custom error handling.

args.answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE sp(
    arg1 integer,
    arg2 text,
    arg3 integer,
    arg4 integer,
    arg5 text,
    arg6 integer
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
    i integer;
BEGIN
    -- Phase passes 1..9
    FOR i IN 1..9 LOOP
        -- Mark current players, then remove those below the phase threshold
        UPDATE "Player"
        SET "birthday" = 'phase_' || i::text;

        DELETE FROM "Player"
        WHERE "player_api_id" < (arg3 + i - 1);

        -- Mark current teams, then remove those below the phase threshold
        UPDATE "Team"
        SET "team_short_name" = 'log_phase_' || i::text;

        DELETE FROM "Team"
        WHERE "team_fifa_api_id" < (arg6 + i - 1);
    END LOOP;

    -- Weight bump for remaining short players
    UPDATE "Player"
    SET "weight" = "weight" + 1
    WHERE "height" < arg1;

    -- Optional long-name update
    IF arg5 IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE "Team"
        SET "team_long_name" = arg5
        WHERE "team_short_name" = 'log_phase_9'
          AND "team_api_id" >= arg4;
    END IF;

    -- Correct player skill snapshots (independent of current Player existence)
    UPDATE "Player_Attributes"
    SET "potential" = "overall_rating"
    WHERE "player_api_id" >= (arg3 + 8)
      AND "potential" < "overall_rating";

    -- Correct team tactical snapshots only for qualifying current teams
    UPDATE "Team_Attributes" AS ta
    SET "defenceAggression" = ta."defencePressure"
    FROM "Team" AS t
    WHERE t."team_api_id" = ta."team_api_id"
      AND t."team_fifa_api_id" >= (arg6 + 8)
      AND ta."defenceAggression" < ta."defencePressure";
END;
$$;
